timeline.text: Every button on my site felt different — some flat, some barely reacting when you pressed them.
The home-screen tiles weren't any better — they just grew a little on hover, nothing felt physical.
So I built one CSS recipe — an embossed shadow that makes anything look pressed.
Now every circular button uses it, in light mode and dark, across every palette.
The tiles got the same recipe too — one shadow language, six tiles, pressed into the page.
